d1ExecutionPrerequisite.failureBehavior: hosted qualification and deployment remain blocked; a platform-limit or timeout response is not migration evidence

profiles.preservation: exact projection of every legacy plays column and all semantic migration receipt fields

failureInjection.statement: qualification-only read from an intentionally missing table

atomicity.migrationUnit: one D1 batch for the entire requested migration range
atomicity.prewriteGuard: schema version, exact catalog, exact row projection, and accepted ordered byte authority are revalidated inside the batch
atomicity.terminalGuard: exact terminal catalog, expected row cardinalities, semantic receipts, fixture row, and integrity preconditions must pass before the guard table can be dropped
atomicity.retry: an already verified target state returns the same deterministic receipt
atomicity.partialFailure: any injected or natural statement failure must reject the D1 batch and preserve the exact prestate

schemaClaimBoundary.acceptedByHarness: same object names, types, owning tables, exact raw sqlite_schema SQL, normalized SQL tokens, object counts, exact expected rows, valid semantic migration receipts, foreign-key check, and quick-check
schemaClaimBoundary.unacceptedProof: the hosted harness does not recompute the d24 physical manifest over table_xinfo, index_xinfo, foreign_key_list, collations, key flags, hidden columns, defaults, and related engine-interpreted details
schemaClaimBoundary.consequence: a passing hosted run remains raw-catalog and DDL parity evidence; D1 physical-manifest parity requires a separate proof before OS-01 or ARC-03 acceptance

logicalBackup.sourceRows: all legacy tables, explicit columns, ordered rows, per-row hashes, per-table hashes, and one whole-manifest hash
logicalBackup.corruptionBehavior: reject before the first database write
logicalBackup.blockedReason: accepted migrations create append-only receipt rows with D1-generated applied_at values; replaying into a distinct D1 changes exact receipt rows, and the qualification harness refuses to normalize, exempt, update, drop, disable, or bypass that append-only evidence
logicalBackup.requiredSuccessorProof: an exact distinct-resource export/import or platform backup/restore path preserving every receipt byte and whole rows hash
logicalBackup.negativeControl: restore_import returns exact_distinct_restore_unavailable before the first database write

package.reproducibility: two empty output directories with the same staging project id must produce identical entry, authority, and manifest hashes
package.productionReachability: worker/index.ts does not import or route to this entry

receiptProtocol.requestIdentity: 256-bit qualification id plus one closed action
receiptProtocol.response: stable JSON with a self hash and zero provider, binding-read, and capture counters
receiptProtocol.operatorRetention: preserve exact request bytes, response bytes, HTTP status, package manifest bytes, manifest digest, project access observation, D1 observations, and retirement observation under exclusive immutable filenames
receiptProtocol.duplicateBehavior: never overwrite an existing hosted receipt directory

claimBoundary: This contract is terminally capacity-blocked. Semicolon-aware accounting proves that blank replay requires 291 migration statements, 295 statements in one atomic batch, and 489 D1 queries in one Worker invocation. No authoritative Sites effective query-limit proof or under-30-second execution proof exists, and no atomic successor fits the documented 50-query Free limit. Do not deploy. Local tests do not qualify a hosted path. Exact distinct-resource restoration and D1 physical-manifest parity remain unaccepted. It does not establish a production prestate, accept OS-01 or ARC-03, authorize or apply a production migration, activate capture, access a provider, or access the real retained lock.
